EFFECTS.name: Cinema Look
EFFECTS.desc: Turns a live camera into a film: teal-and-orange grade, filmic highlights, red halation glow, grain, gate weave and an optional 2.39 letterbox.

EFFECTS.name: Hologram
EFFECTS.desc: The performer as a projected hologram: tinted light, scanlines, edge glow, flicker, glitch tears on the beat, and a projector beam. Dark areas fall away.

EFFECTS.name: Thermal
EFFECTS.desc: Thermal-camera look for live feeds: iron, rainbow or arctic palettes, white-hot or black-hot, a scale bar and crosshair, and a heat pulse on the beat.

EFFECTS.name: Clone Wall
EFFECTS.desc: The live feed repeated in a grid, each tile a few frames behind the last so movement ripples across the wall. Pop colours per tile, and the order can reshuffle on the beat.

EFFECTS.name: Pop Duotone
EFFECTS.desc: Screen-print poster look: posterised duotone, halftone dots, bold outlines and off-register ink. The palette can flip every bar.

EFFECTS.name: VHS Camcorder
EFFECTS.desc: The live feed as a 90s camcorder tape: line wobble, a rolling tracking band, chroma bleed, tape noise, dropouts, head-switching at the bottom and a blinking REC dot.

EFFECTS.name: Point Cloud
EFFECTS.desc: The live feed rebuilt as a 3D cloud of glowing points, pushed forward by brightness and orbiting slowly like a volumetric capture. Kicks punch the depth.

EFFECTS.name: Dream Bloom
EFFECTS.desc: A beauty glow for live feeds: soft diffusion, prism fringes, four-point star glints on highlights, a pastel grade and drifting light leaks.

EFFECTS.name: Aura
EFFECTS.desc: An energy aura streams off the outline of whoever is on camera, rising and swirling like heat, with colour drifting through it. Kicks flare it up.

EFFECTS.name: Aura · Flame
EFFECTS.desc: Flames rise off the performer’s outline and cool from white-hot to deep red as they climb. Set Flame hue for blue or green fire.

EFFECTS.name: Aura · Photo
EFFECTS.desc: Inspired by aura-camera portraits: soft clouds of colour bloom around the person like a double exposure, with an instant-film finish.

EFFECTS.name: Aura · Electric
EFFECTS.desc: Crackling plasma arcs branch off the performer, flickering between beats and surging outward on every kick.

EFFECTS.name: Aura · Embers
EFFECTS.desc: Glowing embers drift up through a soft halo around the performer, twinkling as they rise. Kicks brighten them.

EFFECTS.name: Aura · Rings
EFFECTS.desc: Outline-shaped rings ripple outward from the performer like sonar, with a bright shock ring on every beat.

EFFECTS.name: Aura · Neon Stroke
EFFECTS.desc: Stacked neon outlines trace the performer at growing distances, each its own colour, breathing outward on the beat.

EFFECTS.name: Aura · Ghost Trail
EFFECTS.desc: Coloured ghost silhouettes from the last moments trail behind the performer, so every move leaves a spectral echo.

EFFECTS.name: Aura · Radiance
EFFECTS.desc: Shafts of light burst outward from behind the performer, a heavenly walk-on glow with a shimmer in the rays.

EFFECTS.name: Liquid Wipe
EFFECTS.desc: B floods in behind an organic liquid front with a glowing rim that bends both pictures as it passes. Set any angle.

EFFECTS.name: Flash Burn
EFFECTS.desc: A blows out into a bright overexposed flash with bloom and lens streaks, and B emerges from the light. The classic keynote reveal, turned up.

EFFECTS.name: Whip Zoom
EFFECTS.desc: A rockets into the screen with radial blur, a twist and colour split, and B whips back out of it. Punchy for drops.

EFFECTS.name: Slice Slide
EFFECTS.desc: The frame splits into strips that slide away in alternating directions with a staggered, eased motion and motion blur, carrying B in behind them.

EFFECTS.name: Smoke Reveal
EFFECTS.desc: A dissolves into rising smoke and B forms out of it, with soft lit wisps along the edge.

EFFECTS.name: Pixel Stream
EFFECTS.desc: Rows of A smear sideways into pixel-sorted streaks at random times, and B is left behind as they rush off. Clean digital chaos.

EFFECTS.name: Halo Iris
EFFECTS.desc: B opens out of the centre inside an expanding ring of light that wobbles like liquid and bends both pictures at its edge.

EFFECTS.name: Cube Turn
EFFECTS.desc: A and B on two faces of a 3D cube that swings round, pulling back mid-turn so you feel the depth, with light falling across the faces.

EFFECTS.name: Light Dissolve
EFFECTS.desc: B burns through A starting from the brightest parts (or the darkest), with a glowing line of light tracing the dissolve.

EFFECTS.name: Spectrum Split
EFFECTS.desc: Red, green and blue tear apart in three directions, each swapping from A to B at its own moment, then snap back together on B.

EFFECTS.name: Chrome Ribbon
EFFECTS.desc: A liquid-metal frame that flows and ripples on the beat, with thin-film colour and a soft shadow cast onto your content.

EFFECTS.name: Bulb Marquee
EFFECTS.desc: A theatre marquee of light bulbs around the frame. The chase pattern changes every bar: run, blink, opposing comets, sparkle.

EFFECTS.name: Halo Frame
EFFECTS.desc: A premium frosted-glass frame: the clip blurs into the glass band, a soft light glides along the inner edge, and the window casts a gentle shadow inward. Built for keynotes, award shows and concerts.

EFFECTS.name: Halo · Aurora
EFFECTS.desc: A fine line of light around the frame with aurora colours flowing along it and soft curtains drifting inward.

EFFECTS.name: Halo · Corners
EFFECTS.desc: Minimal broadcast framing: corner brackets that redraw every 4 bars, a hairline frame, ruler ticks, centre marks and a light that travels the edge.

EFFECTS.name: Slice Trace
EFFECTS.desc: White light flows around each LED slice like liquid. Streaks stretch, taper, split and drain away unpredictably, thinning to fine tips.

EFFECTS.name: Slice Trace · Mercury
EFFECTS.desc: Liquid metal running around each slice: rounded silver beads that swell, merge and split, catching a moving highlight.

EFFECTS.name: Slice Trace · Neon Liquid
EFFECTS.desc: The same liquid flow in colour: streams of neon whose hue drifts along the outline, with a white-hot core and soft bloom.

EFFECTS.name: Slice Trace · Surge
EFFECTS.desc: Calm liquid streaks until the beat hits: then a surge pours from the top of each slice and races down both sides before draining away.

EFFECTS.name: Slice Trace · Braid
EFFECTS.desc: Two liquid streams, one white and one in an accent colour, weave over and under each other as they flow around every slice.

EFFECTS.name: Slice Trace · Spill
EFFECTS.desc: The liquid outline spills light into each slice: wherever a streak flows, a soft wash bleeds inward and ripples, then fades as the streak moves on.

EFFECTS.name: Caustics
EFFECTS.desc: Underwater light caustics dance across the clip and bend it, like the whole stage is at the bottom of a pool.

EFFECTS.name: Caustics · God Rays
EFFECTS.desc: Deep-water look: caustics on the clip, slanted light shafts falling from the surface and drifting particles.

EFFECTS.name: Caustics · Prism
EFFECTS.desc: Caustics split into red, green and blue so every light line carries a rainbow fringe, over a darkened, refracted clip.

EFFECTS.name: Caustics · Raindrops
EFFECTS.desc: Drops land on the beat and send rippling rings across the clip, bending it and catching highlights, over a faint caustic floor.

EFFECTS.name: Ink Bloom
EFFECTS.desc: An organic ink mask that blooms open and closes again over 1, 2, 4 or 8 beats, with a glowing wet edge.

EFFECTS.name: Ink · Smoke
EFFECTS.desc: The clip rises out of darkness through drifting smoke and sinks back, with soft lit wisps along the edge.

EFFECTS.name: Ink · Burn
EFFECTS.desc: The clip burns away like paper, with a flame front, charred edge, heat shimmer and embers, then reforms.

EFFECTS.name: Ink · Watercolour
EFFECTS.desc: Three pigment drops bloom across the frame with dark rims and paper grain, revealing the clip tinted in their colours. New drops each cycle.

EFFECTS.name: Type Cutout
EFFECTS.desc: The clip shows only through a giant word that punches on the beat. Raise Rows to tile it into scrolling lines.

EFFECTS.name: Flip Grid
EFFECTS.desc: The frame splits into tiles that flip over in a 3D wave every bar, revealing a hue-shifted back side. The wave origin alternates.

EFFECTS.name: Disintegrate
EFFECTS.desc: The clip crumbles into glowing particles that blow away on the wind, then reassembles, over 2 to 16 beats.

EFFECTS.name: Type · Carousel
EFFECTS.desc: The scrolling word rows from the Kinetic type source, now as an effect: alternating directions, outline rows, a light sweep, and optional beat-snapped motion. Change the word in Word.

EFFECTS.name: Type · Wave
EFFECTS.desc: Word rows ride a travelling sine wave while they scroll, like a flag in the wind. Kicks make the wave surge.

EFFECTS.name: Type · Cylinder
EFFECTS.desc: The word wrapped around spinning 3D drums, a literal carousel. You see the back of the drum through the gaps.

EFFECTS.name: Type · Slam
EFFECTS.desc: On every beat a row slams in from alternating sides with overshoot, motion blur and a flash, building a stack.

EFFECTS.name: Type · Echo Stack
EFFECTS.desc: A solid word at the centre throws a stream of outline copies that grow outward through the colour wheel. Beats push the stream.

EFFECTS.name: LED Wall
EFFECTS.desc: Rebuilds the clip as an LED panel with RGB sub-pixels, bloom and a beat ripple. Crossfade to a rotated halftone.

EFFECTS.name: Contour
EFFECTS.desc: Topographic lines traced from the clip’s brightness, flowing downhill and cycling through the palette.

EFFECTS.name: Edge Neon
EFFECTS.desc: Traces every outline in the clip as glowing neon tubing, coloured by edge direction, over a dimmed or black background.

EFFECTS.name: ASCII
EFFECTS.desc: Rebuilds the clip from text characters by brightness, with glyph flicker and a beat wave rolling down the screen.

EFFECTS.name: Rutt-Etra
EFFECTS.desc: The classic analogue video-synth look: scanlines lifted into 3D by brightness, tilted like a landscape.

EFFECTS.name: Op-Art
EFFECTS.desc: Bold black-and-white line fields bent by the clip’s brightness, with moiré interference and a beat pulse rippling outward.

EFFECTS.name: Echo Tunnel
EFFECTS.desc: Every frame is fed back into the next, zoomed, rotated and hue-shifted, for endless trails. Key sets what cuts through.

EFFECTS.name: Echo · Kaleido
EFFECTS.desc: Feedback folded through a kaleidoscope, so the trails grow into a living mandala.

EFFECTS.name: Echo · Vortex
EFFECTS.desc: Trails get pulled into a spinning vortex at the centre, cycling colour with every generation. Kicks tighten the spin.

EFFECTS.name: Echo · Stutter
EFFECTS.desc: Beat-quantised freeze-frames: copies of the bright parts are stamped on every 1/2, 1/4 or 1/8 note and trail behind like a multi-exposure photo.

EFFECTS.name: Paint Melt
EFFECTS.desc: Feedback pushed through a curl-noise flow field, so the clip smears and swirls like wet paint. Beats stir it harder.

EFFECTS.name: Melt · Drip
EFFECTS.desc: Wet paint running down a wall: trails slide downward at uneven speeds with a sideways wobble.

EFFECTS.name: Melt · Marble
EFFECTS.desc: Orbiting vortices swirl the trails into marbled paper patterns, with the clip combed in as stripes.

EFFECTS.name: Melt · Inferno
EFFECTS.desc: The clip feeds a fire: heat rises through curling turbulence and cools from white to yellow to red to black.

EFFECTS.name: Slit Scan
EFFECTS.desc: Each slice of the frame shows a different moment in the last second, so motion stretches and bends through time.

EFFECTS.name: RGB Time Split
EFFECTS.desc: Red, green and blue each lag by a different number of frames, so anything moving tears into colour ghosts. Beats stretch the gap.

EFFECTS.name: Time Tiles
EFFECTS.desc: Datamosh-style tiles, each replaying a different moment from the frame buffer, reshuffled on the beat.
